title: The Blade Reforged
description: Gain a **Signature Weapon**, following the Fighter's Starting Move of the same name or give it two more enhancements or gain a second Signature Weapon.

outcomes.text: Either give it two more enhancements or gain a second Signature Weapon.

submoves.title: Enhance
submoves.description: When you **Enjoy Downtime**, you may also do the following: spend 1 Treasure and choose a magic item or Artifact. It becomes part of your Signature Weapon, which gains the item's properties, Moves, and whichever #tags make sense. A Signature Weapon may only be grafted with one item at a time; a previously-grafted item can be split as part of this activity.

title: Advanced Fighting Styles
description: You've mastered an especially difficult or obscure fighting style. Choose one below:
pickOne: Might of Arms. You can comfortably wield **two-handed** melee weapons in one hand, and even dual-wield them
Point Blank. All ranged weapons you wield gain **hand** and **close**. While using one up **close** or closer, deal +1 dmg
Spellbreaker. When a **close** NPC tries to create a magical effect, you may interrupt and stop it; mark a Condition from backlash

title: Boot Knife
description: Any weapon that isn't **two-handed** can be easily **concealed** by you. Gain a set of adventuring gear (even if you already have one). You may mark a use of adventuring gear to withdraw a mundane weapon; mark an additional use if the weapon is **two-handed**.

submoves.title: The Hand That Wields
submoves.description: When you **Trade Blows** with an ordinary weapon, or no weapon at all, on a 10+, you may instead choose to clear a Condition and, on a 6-, mark 2 XP instead of 1. When you finally draw your **Signature Weapon** after trying to defeat a foe without it, until the fight ends, after you roll to **Trade Blows** you may mark a Condition to increase the result by one step (6- → 7-9 → 10+).

title: Snap the Blade
description: When you **inflict dmg with a weapon**, after the dmg roll you may temporarily break the weapon (if it isn't indestructible) to instead deal max dmg. The weapon becomes nearly useless until repaired.

outcomes.text: When you **Make Camp**, you may repair one **Signature Weapon** or mundane weapon that has been broken in this or a similar way.
